programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.headline: United Airlines Focuses on Premium Experience and Loyalty to Drive Retention
stories.lead: An 18-page report by IdeaWorksCompany highlights United Airlines' strategy centered on premium customer proposition, loyalty programs, co-branded credit cards, and ancillary revenue. Authored by Jay Sorensen, the report examines initiatives introduced throughout 2025 and 2026.
stories.source_description: United Airlines is rapidly reshaping its customer proposition around premium experiences, loyalty, co-branded cards and ancillary revenue, according to a new 18-page IdeaWorksCompany report, “United is Winning the Race for Brand-Loyal Consumers.” Written by airline revenue and loyalty expert Jay Sorensen, the report examines United’s expanding portfolio of products and strategies introduced during 2025 and 2026. United’s lounge network, with 50+ locations, is another critical component of its brand-loyal strategy. The report estimates its network serves about 70,000 daily guests. That’s more than 25 million guests per year, which is equal to the annual passenger traffic of JetBlue. stories.headline: Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo Sign MoU for Expanded Cooperation
stories.lead: Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo signed a Memorandum of Understanding on 17 November 2026 to enhance global network connectivity and interline cargo services.
stories.source_description: Shared commitment to operational excellence, with an ambition to set a new standard for interline cargo. Greater connectivity across complementary global networks, creating more choice and opportunities for customers. First active pharma interline agreement between the carriers, opening new possibilities for highly sensitive healthcare shipments. Simpler, more seamless interline booking, building on over a decade of collaboration and 2,000 tonnes of cargo transported in H1 2026. Dubai/ London, 17 November 2026 - Building on more than a decade of successful collaboration, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to take their partnership further, delivering excellence and expanding possibilities for customers worldwide. Bringing together complementary global networks, aligned operational standards and specialist expertise, the MoU aims to set a new benchmark for interline cargo. Beyond expanding connectivity, the carriers share an ambition to create a seamless, reliable experience that makes interlining a preferred choice for customers, rather than simply an alternative to direct services. The agreement was signed at Emirates Group Headquarters in Dubai by Badr Abbas, Divisional Senior Vice President, Emirates SkyCargo , and Nick Diesel, Managing Director, Virgin Atlantic Cargo. Under the MoU, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will explore opportunities to expand cargo interline arrangements and Block Space Agreements (BSAs), strengthening eastbound and westbound connectivity and facilitating global trade. Together, their networks span 158 destinations, creating further opportunities for Emirates SkyCargo across the Americas and Virgin Atlantic Cargo across the Middle East and Asia. The MoU will also enable Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo to interline highly sensitive active pharmaceutical shipments for the first time. Active pharma shipments require the highest levels of protection and zero disruption while in transit, to ensure sensitive products – such as vaccines and insulin – maintain their efficacy. By combining their industry-leading expertise in life sciences and healthcare logistics with the strength of their existing partnership, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will be able to transport even the most sensitive shipments with no compromise on quality, care or reliability. The UK provides a natural connection point between the two carriers’ networks, linking the US, Asia and the Middle East through an unbroken cold chain and supporting the fast, reliable movement of critical healthcare products. Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will also collaborate on ways to make interline booking simpler and more seamless. By exploring enhanced digital solutions, the partners aim to streamline the online booking journey, helping customers receive faster responses and greater visibility of confirmed itineraries on other airlines. Commenting on the partnership, Badr Abbas said , “Establishing strategic partnerships with industry-leading airlines whose strengths complement our own is a key pillar of Emirates SkyCargo’s long-term growth strategy. Our agreement with Virgin Atlantic Cargo delivers immediate benefits to our customers by expanding network reach, increasing capacity, and creating greater connectivity across key global markets. It also allows us to enhance our offering with innovative solutions, including the transportation of active pharmaceutical shipments via interline connections. We look forward to working closely with Virgin Atlantic Cargo to ensure seamless operations while continuing to develop future-focused solutions that address the evolving supply chain needs of our customers.” Nick Diesel, Managing Director at Virgin Atlantic Cargo , added, “We’ve worked closely with Emirates SkyCargo for more than a decade, so this MoU is a natural next step in a relationship built on operational excellence, complementary strengths and a shared commitment to our customers. “Our ambition is to set a new standard for interline cargo. We know customers value the simplicity and confidence of booking direct, and we want to bring that same experience to interline shipments. By combining our expertise and aligning how we manage bookings, handovers and shipment visibility, we aim to make interlining a preferred choice for its quality, reliability and ease. This is about delivering excellence at every connection, while opening up more possibilities for our customers.” With a partnership spanning more than a decade, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo transported a combined 2,000 tonnes of cargo in the first half of 2026, carrying commodities such as passive pharma, perishables and general cargo between the Americas, Europe, West Asia and the Middle East. The recently signed agreement lays the foundation for further growth, combining each carrier’s unique expertise to create stronger connections, improve trade flows and unlock new opportunities for customers and markets around the world.

stories.headline: Delta and Hyatt Launch Strategic Loyalty Partnership
stories.lead: Delta SkyMiles and World of Hyatt have officially launched a long-term strategic relationship, allowing members to link accounts and earn reciprocal benefits.
stories.source_description: Delta and Hyatt’s new long-term strategic relationship launches today, bringing eligible Delta SkyMiles® and World of Hyatt® members new ways to earn and access benefits across both programs when they link their accounts at delta.com/WorldOfHyatt . First announced in September, the relationship brings together two leading brands to help connect the air and hotel experience, with a shared ambition to create more value and recognition across the travel journey. Together, Delta SkyMiles and World of Hyatt are creating a more connected experience that recognizes members and rewards them for their travel and what they’ve earned across both brands. “At Delta, we know loyalty is something we earn by delivering meaningful value and experiences that make our Members want to keep choosing us,” said Dwight James, S.V.P. – Customer Engagement & Loyalty and CEO, Delta Vacations. “Our relationship with World of Hyatt gives us another way to do that by recognizing and rewarding Members across more of their travel, while creating new ways to earn, engage and experience both brands.” “World of Hyatt and Delta SkyMiles were each built to make travel more meaningful and rewarding, which makes this collaboration feel meant to be,” said Laurie Blair, Senior Vice President, Global Marketing and Loyalty, Hyatt. “By connecting the Delta flight and Hyatt stay, we are helping members get more from the journeys they are already taking while opening the door to new experiences, destinations and memories. It is an exciting next step in our commitment to caring for members throughout the full travel journey, from takeoff to check out.” Read on to discover what the new relationship means for Members and how to start taking advantage of the benefits today. AT A GLANCE: Link your accounts to get started: All members can connect their SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts to access eligible offers and experiences. Discover double the benefits: Eligible Medallion Members and World of Hyatt elite members can earn across qualifying Hyatt stays and Delta flights. More ways to turn loyalty into rewards in 2027: Qualifying linked members in both programs can select new rewards from the other program as they reach eligible milestones. Limited-time offers for linked members: Linked members can access special earning opportunities to celebrate the launch. Enter for a chance to win the ultimate Delta x World of Hyatt getaway: SkyMiles Members can enter through SkyMiles Experiences for the chance to experience the best of both brands on a special getaway to Alila Mayakoba in Riviera Maya. (NO PURCHASE NECESSARY; see details below*) *NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. Open to legal residents of the 50 U.S./D.C., age 21+. Void outside the 50 U.S./D.C. and where prohibited. Sweepstakes starts at 6:00:00 AM ET on 11/17/2026; ends at 11:59:59 PM ET on 11/23/2026. Odds of winning depend on the number of entries received. All members, regardless of status, can link their accounts to access limited-time offers and experiences, including special opportunities celebrating the launch. Linking also keeps accounts connected, making it easier to discover and take advantage of other eligible offers and benefits as they become available. Already a member of both programs? Start by logging in to your SkyMiles Account to link your accounts. Not yet a member? Join SkyMiles and World of Hyatt for free, then link your accounts here to get started. Discover double the benefits Your journey is made of flights and stays, and now your rewards can come from both. Once accounts are successfully linked, eligible Medallion Members can earn miles on qualifying Hyatt stays, while elite World of Hyatt members can earn Bonus Points on qualifying Delta premium cabin flights. Eligible Members include Delta Diamond, Platinum, Gold and Silver Medallion Members, as well as World of Hyatt Discoverist, Explorist Globalist and Lifetime Globalist Members. Qualifying Delta premium cabin flights include Delta Comfort, Delta Premium Select, Delta First Class and Delta One. All Delta fare experiences, including Basic, Classic and Extra, are eligible when purchased in an eligible premium cabin. Other terms and restrictions apply. See terms for details. Beginning Feb. 1, 2027, with the start of the 2028 Medallion Year, qualifying SkyMiles Members will also have new ways to turn their loyalty into memorable World of Hyatt stays. Through Delta Choice Benefits, eligible Members can select World of Hyatt Free Night Awards as a 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit, including: A Category 1-4 Free Night Award as a Platinum Choice Benefit A Category 1-7 Free Night Award as a Diamond Choice Benefit And beginning Jan. 1, 2027, World of Hyatt members can choose from a range of Delta awards as they reach qualifying Milestone Rewards thresholds. The first Delta award choice will become available at 20 qualifying nights or 35,000 Base Points, with additional choices as members progress through the program, including: Delta e-certificates in varying amounts at milestones from 20 to 60 qualifying nights Two Single Visit Delta Sky Club® passes at 70, 80 and 90 qualifying nights Opportunities to receive Delta Medallion Status (without access to Choice Benefits) at milestones from 100 to 150 qualifying nights Together, the new choices give members more ways to use the loyalty they’ve earned with one brand toward travel with the other. Limited-time offers for linked members Earn 1,000 Delta miles and 1,000 World of Hyatt points: To celebrate the launch, Delta and Hyatt are introducing a series of limited-time offers for members who link their accounts. All Linked Members can earn 1,000 Delta miles on their first stay at a participating Hyatt® hotel and resort completed between Jan. 4, 2027 and Feb. 15, 2027. All Linked Members can earn 1,000 World of Hyatt points on their first flight on an eligible Delta premium cabin completed between Jan. 4, 2027 and Feb. 15, 2027. See terms for eligibility, exclusions, and other terms and conditions . Enter to win the ultimate Delta x World of Hyatt getaway What better way to bring Delta and Hyatt’s new relationship to life than by getting away together? Also beginning today, SkyMiles Members can visit SkyMiles Experiences and enter the Group Drop and enter with a friend for the chance to escape to Alila Mayakoba , part of Hyatt’s Luxury Portfolio, in Riviera Maya, Mexico from Jan. 22-25 – no miles or point required to enter. The retreat’s carefully curated experiences and the choice to follow your own pace make every moment feel effortless. The journey includes an immersive curated experience, an intimate evening as the sun goes down, and a Delta lounge pop-up that’s yours to drop in throughout your stay at Alila Mayakoba. Members who link their SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts before entering the sweepstakes will be eligible for one additional entry to win. See terms below. Bringing together the best of both brands, the getaway is designed to showcase a shared approach to delivering premium travel experiences, with the kind of thoughtful hospitality, memorable moments and sense of discovery that are uniquely Delta and Hyatt. The benefits launching today are just the start of Delta and Hyatt’s shared ambition to make travel more connected and rewarding, bringing together the best of both brands across more of the journey. stories.headline: Emirates Aviation University Hosts IAMC 2026 Focused on Digital Transformation
stories.lead: More than 250 aviation industry professionals and academics assembled at Emirates Aviation University for the sixth edition of the International Aviation Management Conference.
stories.source_description: Dubai, UAE, 16 November 2026 - More than 250 aviation industry professionals, academics, researchers and industry representatives have gathered at Emirates Aviation University (EAU) for the sixth edition of the biennial International Aviation Management Conference (IAMC 2026). The two-day forum, taking place on 16 and 17 November 2026 and held under the patronage of His Highness Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum , Chairman and Chief Executive of Emirates Airline & Group, brings together leading voices from industry and academia to exchange knowledge, share research findings and discuss the technologies, trends and innovations reshaping the global aviation sector. This year’s event is focused on the future of digital transformation in aviation. Featuring keynote presentations, research paper sessions and expert panel discussions, the conference proceedings will help examine how emerging technologies are reshaping aviation operations, driving efficiency, enhancing customer experiences and helping the industry prepare for future challenges. Professor Dr Ahmad Al Ali, Vice Chancellor Emirates Aviation University, said: "Digital transformation is fundamentally changing the aviation industry, creating new opportunities to improve efficiency, resilience and customer experience. Through IAMC 2026, we aim to bring together leading minds from industry and academia to share insights, showcase innovative research and explore how technology can help shape a smarter and more sustainable future for aviation. We are proud to host the conference for the sixth consecutive year and look forward to welcoming delegates from across the global aviation community." The opening session of the conference programme featured keynote addresses from leading figures across the aviation ecosystem, including Talal Al Hammadi , Vice President of Air Traffic Development at Dubai Air Navigation Services (dans); Kashif Khalid , Director, Operations, Safety & Security Affairs at IATA; Mohammed Abubaker Farea , former ICAO Middle East Regional Director; Dr. Selda Konukcu , Senior Director of Commercial Aircraft Sales at Airbus; and Prof. Bijan Vasigh of Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University. IAMC 2026 builds on the success of previous editions, which have established the conference as a leading platform for discussing emerging trends, sharing research findings and strengthening partnerships between industry and academia. The event reflects Emirates Aviation University's ongoing commitment to advancing aviation knowledge, supporting innovation and contributing to the development of future industry leaders.

stories.headline: Emirates Showcases Airbus A350 in Nairobi and Introduces Premium Economy
stories.lead: Emirates hosted an aircraft tour at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi following the deployment of its Airbus A350 on the Dubai-Nairobi route. The aircraft introduces the airline's Premium Economy cabin to the Kenyan market while complementing its existing double daily Boeing 777 service.
stories.source_description: Nairobi, Kenya, 16 November 2026: Following the deployment of the Airbus A350 on the Dubai-Nairobi route, Emirates, the world’s largest international airline, hosted a guided tour of the aircraft at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. The event showcased the airline’s next generation in flight experience and debuted the highly acclaimed Premium Economy Cabin to Kenya’s travel trade. Commenting on the deployment, Christophe Leloup said, “Bringing the Emirates A350 to Kenya is an important step in our continued investment in the market and the experience we offer our customers. Featuring our latest generation interiors, including Premium Economy, the aircraft brings more choice, comfort and connectivity to travellers and complements our existing double daily Boeing 777 service. By showcasing our latest products first-hand the travel trade, we are demonstrating how we are improving the customer journey, giving them the knowledge and confidence to share those benefits with travellers. Our travel trade partners play an invaluable role in connecting Kenya to our global network and showcasing the country’s appeal to international tourists. We look forward to further building on these strong partnerships, unlocking new opportunities for tourism and trade and bring an even better travel experience to our customers travelling to and from Kenya, aboard this aircraft.” More choice, connectivity and customer demand Emirates introduced the third daily flight, EK717 and EK718, on the Dubai-Nairobi route this summer, adding an early morning arrival and departure in Nairobi, and providing customers with more convenient connections to major US and European gateways. The additional frequency has been in high demand since launch, operating at high seat load factors, which further spiked with the launch of the Emirates A350 on 25 October 2026. The sustained demand in both directions reflects the strong customer interest in the airline’s latest-generation aircraft and Premium Economy cabin, especially for ultra-long-haul travel. A closer look at the Emirates A350 The Emirates A350 is the newest aircraft type to join Emirates’ all widebody fleet of aircraft and introduces the latest product and inflight experience to Nairobi. Spacious, bright cabins decked out in calming tones of blue and cream are complemented by the latest technology touches and entertainment features. The fully lie-flat Business Class seats are laid out in a 1-2-1 configuration, and the sleek design offers more privacy for passengers to sleep, dine and work. Each seat is equipped with a minibar and wireless charging, and a snack area at the back of the cabin will keep passengers refreshed between serviced meals. Economy Class is light and airy, with the latest generation of seats offering generous recline and legroom for comfort while in flight. ice, Emirates award-winning inflight entertainment system, has been enhanced, offering more content than ever before as well as feature upgrades, such as synchronised play or Bluetooth connectivity with passengers’ own headphones. The Emirates A350 also introduces the airline’s Premium Economy cabin in Nairobi, making luxury travel more accessible to a wider audience with a passenger experience similar to Business Class on many airlines. The cabin offers spacious leather reclining seats with full leg and footrests and adjustable headrests, in-seat charging points and a 13.3-inch TV screen. Dining has also been enhanced, with regionally inspired menus served on Royal Doulton fine china crockery, accompanied by a carefully curated selection of wines. For more information or to book tickets, visit the Emirates website , the Emirates App, the Emirates World Store in Nairobi, Emirates contact centre, or via travel agents. Emirates continues to offer flexible booking policies for added peace of mind and value adds through passengers’ boarding pass and Skywards loyalty programme to unlock exclusive discounts and experiences in Dubai.
